Defeat 2 of the sun tribe's healing priests (cranes).
When the song stopped, one priest pulled his mask halfway off? A scarred left cheek… it's Kael. He looked at you and asked 'where is Roran?' …It's time I told you.
Healing Priest
Chapter 2: The Rusted Vow (19/22)
The Face Beneath the Mask

There's something I have to say. On that last night twenty years ago, Kael pressed this map into my hands and said 'you have to go back.' Then he stayed behind alone to hold them off. I ran without looking back. …I abandoned him. Kael must believe I abandoned him. When we meet that priest, what should I say?
…All right. We'll do as you say. Now we go to bring down the Sunbird.
Tell Kael the truth. He wasn't abandoned — he saved Roran.
Say nothing. Leave Kael someone to blame, at least.
Chapter 2: The Rusted Vow (20/22)
The Blazing Sun

Umvuthi the Sunbird holds Kael captive. Open the Memory Gate. It drives sunlight down from the sky and raises fallen warriors. Take cover in the shade. Bring Umvuthi down and the mask breaks. Then Kael will… come back.
Open the Memory Gate and defeat Umvuthi the Sunbird.

The mask broke. Kael… spent twenty years under that sun. His body couldn't take it. At the end he said, 'It wasn't the captain who froze the sea.' I don't know what he meant. You keep this mask. I can't carry it.
Umvuthi the Sunbird
Chapter Two · The Second Sun
A man who spent twenty years beneath a mask
Kael

Roran… you're late.
…It wasn't the captain who froze the sea.
Chapter 2: The Rusted Vow (21/22)
Twelve Names

Bring the name tags you gathered. Bren, Thomas, Lia, Marco, Ines, and the three from the snow and the mountain. Six is enough. The earth, the snow and the sea took the rest. It's time to burn the roster.
Hand 6 expedition name tags to Captain Roran.
(Roran puts the roster into the campfire. The paper burns slowly.) …Thank you. For the first time in twenty years, I think I'll sleep. Your Corps are my people. Next time we leave no one behind.
Expedition Name Tag
Chapter 2: The Rusted Vow (22/22)

The roster is burned. But one thing remains. Why was Kael's mark erased from the map? It was the Order that sent the expedition. Whoever last touched the map was one of the Order, too. …Report the end of the expedition to Elder Erwin. I can't face him yet.
Report the end of the expedition to Elder Erwin.

(Erwin takes the map and runs a finger over Kael's mark.) "I erased it. It was the Order's custom to erase in advance the places of those who would not return." …A faint heat rose from his glove. The Elder changed the subject. "Worse news, I'm afraid. The sun's power has drifted north and frozen the sea. Before you head to the northern sea, go and see Oscar the fisher."
End of Chapter 2, "The Rusted Vow." No one left behind. This time.
Chapter 3: Logbook of the Frozen Sea (1/19)
The Frozen Net

You're a surveyor? I'm Oscar, a fisher. I haven't hauled in a net once since the sea froze. No, I didn't mean to talk about nets. Fifteen years ago my brother Elric boarded a ship under a captain named Cornelia. They sailed for the northern sea and never came back. But ever since the ice came, every night I hear someone calling names from beneath it.
Listen to Oscar the fisher's story.

Every night I light a lantern on the ice. So Elric won't lose his way. …Foolish, isn't it? Still, since you're heading north, let me ask one favor. If you see sailors' name tags in the ice maze, bring them to me.
Oscar the Fisher
Oscar the Fisher: The sea is honest. It gives back as much as you wait. …But this time I've waited fifteen years and it's given me nothing.
Oscar the Fisher: Elric had a loud laugh. The sound from under the ice… sometimes it sounds like laughter too.
Chapter Three
Logbook of the Frozen Sea
Oscar the fisher, fifteen years of lanterns
Chapter 3: Logbook of the Frozen Sea (2/19)
Edge of the Ice Maze

The whole northern sea has frozen. A maze has formed between the ice, and pirates have built an outpost on top of it. It'll be the expedition's first foothold. Find the pirate outpost. Measure your steps on the ice.
Find the pirate outpost in the ice maze.
The outpost's flag… Cornelia's crew. The captain they say froze along with the sea fifteen years ago. The outpost was empty. Even the plates on the table were left as they were.
Pirate Outpost
Chapter 3: Logbook of the Frozen Sea (3/19)
Tortured Souls
Souls wandering the maze are blocking the way. Defeat them and find the pirate shelter. If any wear name tags around their necks, bring them to Oscar.
Find the pirate shelter and defeat 5 tortured souls.

There was graffiti on the shelter wall. 'The Grey Cloak sold the route.' Grey Cloak…? That's what the Order's old scholars used to wear. And a grey coin was rolling around too. The same coin from chapter 1.
Pirate Shelter
Tortured Soul
Chapter 3: Logbook of the Frozen Sea (4/19)
Call Their Names
You found name tags? Bring them here. I'll call them out one by one. It's all right if it isn't Elric. Someone has to call them.
Hand 2 sailors' name tags to Oscar the fisher.
"Jonas. Bern." …Not Elric. Thank you all the same. I'll have to send word to their families too. Remembering each other's names is what sea folk do.
Sailor's Name Tag
Chapter 3: Logbook of the Frozen Sea (5/19)
Spinefish Soup

The expedition is wearing down in the cold. They say the ice maze's spinefish — as long as you mind the poison spines — are rich in oil and warm you right up. Catch some spinefish and send warm stew along with them. So the expedition can hold out deep into the maze.
Send 6 spinefish and 4 bowls of mushroom stew to the expedition.

Thank you. The expedition can catch its breath. And the northern fishers say the fish vanished because the sea had started to freeze. It was a sign from the very beginning. They say the underwater path in the heart of the maze can be opened now.
Spinefish
Mushroom Stew
Chapter 3: Logbook of the Frozen Sea (6/19)
Flowers on the Ice

Northern sea folk lay flowers on the ice for those who never came back. Wisteria that blooms in the snow — wisteria niveis. Lay flowers for Elric and the sailors. …In fifteen years I've never laid even one. It felt like if I did, it would truly be over.
Bring 4 snow wisteria (wisteria niveis) from the ice maze to Oscar the fisher.
(Oscar lays the flowers on the ice one by one.) …Strange. Now that they're down, I can breathe. It wasn't an ending. It was a farewell. Thank you.
Snow Wisteria
Chapter 3: Logbook of the Frozen Sea (7/19)
Lantern of the Deep

It's pitch black under the ice. Still, some things give off light. The anglerfish hangs a lantern on its head to lure prey, and the abyssal scyphoid glows as it drifts. Bring me an anglerfish's lantern — an esca. Make a lantern from it and even the souls under the ice will follow the light.
Defeat 2 anglerfish and 3 abyssal scyphoids, and bring 1 esca.
(Oscar fits the esca into a lantern frame. Blue light spreads.) Now I can see beneath the ice. …There — something big moved. The one they call the Maze Mother.
Anglerfish
Abyssal Scyphoid
Esca
Chapter 3: Logbook of the Frozen Sea (8/19)
Cracking Ice
Surveyor! Oscar went out onto the ice alone with the new lantern. Calling for Elric. And the ice cracked. The tortured souls are dragging him under! It's the Maze Mother calling!
Defeat 3 tortured souls dragging Oscar down and save him.

(Oscar, soaked and shaking, clutches the lantern.) "…Elric called me from below. I heard him, I'm sure of it. But behind Elric's voice, something enormous was breathing." It's the Maze Mother. She's using the souls as bait.
Souls dragging Oscar
Chapter 3: Logbook of the Frozen Sea (9/19)
The Maze Mother
The thing that guards the maze beneath the ice. The Maze Mother. Fighting it underwater is madness. Open the Memory Gate and drag it out. Everything the maze ever swallowed is in its belly.
Open the Memory Gate and defeat the Maze Mother.
A frozen key came out of its belly. Must be the key to Cornelia's cabin. And… one more name tag. 'Elric.'
It used Elric's voice as bait. Don't forgive it.
Chapter 3: Logbook of the Frozen Sea (10/19)
Graveyard of Ships

The key points to the graveyard of ships. Among the wrecks trapped in the ice swim big-mouthed things and eels. Clear them out. I've arranged diving gear to go under. A helmet bolted shut with three bolts.
Defeat 3 maws and 1 eel in the graveyard of ships.
A sailor's dagger came out of the eel's belly. A grey coin was set in the hilt. …Cornelia's sailors were paid in grey coins. The price of the route they bought, no doubt.
Maw
Eel
Chapter 3: Logbook of the Frozen Sea (11/19)
The Ghost Ship
In the middle of the graveyard is a ship trapped in the ice. Cornelia's ship. That key will open the cabin door. Find a way to summon the captain in the cabin.
Find the ghost ship on the ice.

There was a conch horn on the cabin desk. Blow it and the captain will wake. The seal no longer stops you. Tell Oscar first. …A chart was spread on the desk? One circle in the middle of the sea. 'The eighth Eye.'
